2387.n: TREE: αὐτῶν depends on ῥοπὴν, not on τινα as in the tree. no fitting tag
2387.r: αὐτῶν … καὶ προσόντων καὶ ἀπόντων “whether they were with him or not”: the genitive with ῥοπήν, “turn of the scale in their being present or absent” [SMYTH:1381]. Oblique αὐτός standing alone: the personal pronoun “him, her, it, them” [SMYTH:1212].

2388.r: ἀλλὰ μὴ … οἴοιτο “but lest he should think”: μή with the optative after a verb of fearing in a past tense [SMYTH:2221]. Present stem outside the indicative: aspect only, the action as ongoing [SMYTH:1859]. οἴομαι “think” is middle-only, a middle of mental activity [CONV:D3].

2389.r: ῥοπὴν εἶναι “was of moment”: the predicate of εἶναι [CONV:R5].

2390.r: οἴοιτο … εἶναι “think was”: the infinitive of indirect discourse after οἴομαι [CONV:D7]. In indirect discourse the tense is that of the direct form [CONV:D7]. Active voice [MORPH].

2392.r: καὶ προσόντων “whether present”: the participle agreeing with αὐτῶν [SMYTH:2060]. Present stem outside the indicative: aspect only, the action as ongoing [SMYTH:1859]. Active voice [MORPH].

2394.r: καὶ ἀπόντων “or absent”: the participle agreeing with αὐτῶν [SMYTH:2060]. Present stem outside the indicative: aspect only, the action as ongoing [SMYTH:1859]. Active voice [MORPH].

2396.r: πορευομένων δέ “as they proceeded”: the genitive absolute, αὐτῶν understood, used though τῷ Κύρῳ follows [SMYTH:2072] [COMM:en-holden-1887-books3-5:231]. Present stem outside the indicative: aspect only, the action as ongoing [SMYTH:1859].

2400.r: ἐπεὶ νὺξ ἐπεγένετο “when night came on”: the aorist in a temporal clause [SMYTH:2383]. ἐπιγίγνομαι is a compound of γίγνομαι, middle-only: the spontaneous-process middle [CONV:D3] [CONV:R1]. Indicative of a statement or question [MORPH].

2402.r: λέγεται “it is said”: the present passive [SMYTH:1735]. Indicative of a statement or question [MORPH].

2403.r: φῶς … γενέσθαι “that a light shone forth”: the subject of the infinitive [SMYTH:1972].

2404.r: Article with the proper name Κύρῳ [SMYTH:1136].

2405.r: τῷ Κύρῳ … προφανὲς γενέσθαι “shone forth upon Cyrus”: the dative of the person to whom it appeared [SMYTH:1474].

2407.r: Particular article: στρατεύματι is a definite, identifiable referent [SMYTH:1119].

2408.r: καὶ τῷ στρατεύματι “and his army”: the dative of the person to whom it appeared [SMYTH:1474].

2410.r: Particular article: οὐρανοῦ is a definite, identifiable referent [SMYTH:1119].

2411.r: ἐκ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ “from heaven”: ἐκ with the genitive [PREP:ἐκ] [CONV:D1].

2412.r: προφανὲς γενέσθαι “shone forth”: the predicate of the infinitive [CONV:R5].

2413.r: λέγεται … γενέσθαι “is said to have shone”: the infinitive after the passive λέγεται [SMYTH:1982]. γίγνομαι is middle-only and denotes a change of state without an agent: the spontaneous-process middle [CONV:D3] [CONV:R1].

2416.r: πᾶσι … ἐγγίγνεσθαι “they were all filled”: the dative with a compound of ἐν [SMYTH:1545].

2418.n: TREE: φρίκην is the subject of ἐγγίγνεσθαι, not its object.
2418.r: φρίκην ἐγγίγνεσθαι “awe came upon”: the subject of the infinitive [SMYTH:1972] [COMM:en-gorham-1856:191].

2419.r: ὥστε … ἐγγίγνεσθαι “so that were filled”: ὥστε with the infinitive of result [SMYTH:2260]. Present stem outside the indicative: aspect only, the action as ongoing [SMYTH:1859]. ἐγγίγνομαι is a compound of γίγνομαι, middle-only: the spontaneous-process middle [CONV:D3] [CONV:R1].

2421.r: The article makes θεῖον a substantive [SMYTH:1153].

2422.r: πρὸς τὸ θεῖον “at the miracle”: πρός with the accusative, “in regard to” [PREP:πρός] [COMM:en-holden-1887-books3-5:231] [CONV:R41].

2424.n: TREE: θάρρος is a second subject of ἐγγίγνεσθαι.
2424.r: θάρρος δέ “but courage”: the subject of ἐγγίγνεσθαι understood [SMYTH:1972] [COMM:en-gorham-1856:191].

2427.r: The article makes πολεμίους a substantive [SMYTH:1153].

2428.r: πρὸς τοὺς πολεμίους “to meet the enemy”: πρός with the accusative, “in regard to” [PREP:πρός] [CONV:R41].

2433.r: εὔζωνοί τε … ἐπορεύοντο “were proceeding in light marching order”: a predicate adjective [SMYTH:1043].

2436.r: καὶ ταχύ “with all dispatch”: the adverbial accusative [SMYTH:1609].

2437.r: ὡς … ἐπορεύοντο “as they were proceeding”: the imperfect [SMYTH:1889]; πορεύομαι “march” [CONV:D3]. Indicative of a statement or question [MORPH].

2440.r: Agrees with ὁδὸν and takes its case function [MORPH].

2442.r: πολλήν τε ὁδὸν διήνυσαν “covered a great distance”: the object of διανύω [SMYTH:1553].

2443.r: διήνυσαν “they covered”: the aorist [SMYTH:1923]. Active voice [MORPH]. Indicative of a statement or question [MORPH].

2446.r: ἅμα κνέφᾳ “in the morning twilight”: ἅμα with the dative [SMYTH:1701].

2448.r: πλησίον γίγνονται “they drew near”: the historical present [SMYTH:1883]. γίγνομαι is middle-only and denotes a change of state without an agent: the spontaneous-process middle [CONV:D3] [CONV:R1]. Indicative of a statement or question [MORPH].

2449.r: Particular article: στρατεύματος is a definite, identifiable referent [SMYTH:1119].

2450.r: Article with the proper name Ὑρκανίων [SMYTH:1136].

2451.r: τοῦ τῶν Ὑρκανίων στρατεύματος “the army of the Hyrcanians”: the possessive genitive [SMYTH:1297].

2452.r: πλησίον … τοῦ … στρατεύματος “near the army”: the genitive with an adverb of place [CONV:R122].

2456.r: ὡς δʼ ἔγνωσαν “when they recognized”: the aorist in a temporal clause [SMYTH:2383]. Active voice [MORPH]. Indicative of a statement or question [MORPH].

2457.r: Particular article: ἄγγελοι is a definite, identifiable referent [SMYTH:1119].

2461.r: Article with the proper name Κύρῳ [SMYTH:1136].

2462.r: τῷ Κύρῳ λέγουσιν “reported to Cyrus”: the indirect object [SMYTH:1469].

2463.r: λέγουσιν “they reported”: the historical present [SMYTH:1883]. Active voice [MORPH]. Indicative of a statement or question [MORPH].

2466.r: ὅτι οὗτοί εἰσιν “that these were”: the present, kept in indirect discourse [SMYTH:2579]. Active voice [MORPH]. Indicative of a statement or question [MORPH].

2467.r: The article makes σφέτεροι a substantive [SMYTH:1153].

2468.r: οἱ σφέτεροι “their own people”: a predicate nominative [SMYTH:909].

2470.r: The article turns the infinitive εἶναι into a noun [SMYTH:2025].

2473.r: ὑστάτους εἶναι “were in the rear”: the predicate of the infinitive [CONV:R5].

2474.n: TREE: τῷ … εἶναι depends on γιγνώσκειν.
2474.r: τῷ τε … ὑστάτους εἶναι “by the fact that they were in the rear”: the articular infinitive in the dative of means [SMYTH:2033] [COMM:en-holden-1887-books3-5:231]. Present stem outside the indicative: aspect only, the action as ongoing [SMYTH:1859]. Active voice [MORPH].

2475.r: γιγνώσκειν ἔφασαν “they said they recognized them”: the infinitive of indirect discourse after φημί [CONV:D7] [COMM:en-holden-1887-books3-5:231]. Active voice [MORPH].

2476.r: ἔφασαν “they said”: the imperfect of saying [CONV:R35]. Active voice [MORPH]. Indicative of a statement or question [MORPH].

2478.r: Article with the abstract noun πλήθει [SMYTH:1131].

2479.r: καὶ τῷ πλήθει “and by the number”: the dative of means [SMYTH:1507].

2480.r: Particular article: πυρῶν is a definite, identifiable referent [SMYTH:1119].

2481.r: τῷ πλήθει τῶν πυρῶν “the number of their fires”: the genitive with a word of quantity [SMYTH:1306].

2484.r: ἐκ τούτου “upon hearing this”: ἐκ with the genitive [CONV:R31].

2485.r: πέμπει “he sent”: the historical present [SMYTH:1883]. Active voice [MORPH]. Indicative of a statement or question [MORPH].

2486.r: Particular article: ἕτερον is a definite, identifiable referent [SMYTH:1119].

2487.r: πέμπει τὸν ἕτερον “sent one of the two”: the object [SMYTH:1553] [COMM:en-holden-1887-books3-5:231].

2488.r: τὸν ἕτερον αὐτῶν “one of the two”: the partitive genitive [SMYTH:1306] [COMM:en-bigg-1886-books4-5:122] [COMM:en-holden-1887-books3-5:231]. Oblique αὐτός standing alone: the personal pronoun “him, her, it, them” [SMYTH:1212].

2490.r: πρὸς αὐτούς “to the Hyrcanians themselves”: πρός with the accusative of direction [PREP:πρός] [COMM:en-holden-1887-books3-5:231]. Oblique αὐτός standing alone: the personal pronoun “him, her, it, them” [SMYTH:1212].

2492.r: προστάξας “with orders”: a circumstantial participle [SMYTH:2060]. Agrees with the subject of πέμπει [MORPH]. Aorist stem outside the indicative: aspect only, the action as a single whole [SMYTH:1859]. Active voice [MORPH].

2493.r: προστάξας λέγειν “with orders to say”: the infinitive after a verb of commanding [SMYTH:1992]. Present stem outside the indicative: aspect only, the action as ongoing [SMYTH:1859]. Active voice [MORPH].

2497.n: TREE: the condition goes with ὑπαντᾶν.
2497.r: εἰ φίλοι εἰσίν “if they were friends”: the present indicative, kept in the reported command [SMYTH:2298]. Active voice [MORPH]. Indicative of a statement or question [MORPH].

2500.r: ὡς τάχιστα “as quickly as possible”: the adverbial accusative [SMYTH:1609].

2501.r: λέγειν … ὑπαντᾶν “to bid them come to meet”: λέγω “bid” with the infinitive [SMYTH:1997] [COMM:en-holden-1887-books3-5:231]. Present stem outside the indicative: aspect only, the action as ongoing [SMYTH:1859]. Active voice [MORPH].

2502.r: The article makes δεξιὰς a substantive [SMYTH:1153].

2503.r: τὰς δεξιὰς ἀνατείναντας “with their right hands raised”: the object [SMYTH:1553] [COMM:en-holden-1887-books3-5:231].

2504.r: ὑπαντᾶν … ἀνατείναντας “come to meet, raising”: the participle agrees with the unexpressed subject of the infinitive [CONV:R92] [COMM:en-holden-1887-books3-5:231]. Aorist stem outside the indicative: aspect only, the action as a single whole [SMYTH:1859]. Active voice [MORPH].

2506.r: συμπέμπει “he sent along”: the historical present [SMYTH:1883]. Active voice [MORPH]. Indicative of a statement or question [MORPH].

2510.n: TREE: τῶν σὺν ἑαυτῷ depends on τινα.
2510.r: τινα … τῶν σὺν ἑαυτῷ “one of his own men”: the article with a prepositional phrase as a noun, in the partitive genitive [SMYTH:1153].

2512.r: Dative with σύν, “with”: accompaniment [PREP:σύν]; the tag gives the function of the phrase [CONV:D1].

2514.r: λέγειν ἐκέλευσε “ordered him to tell”: the infinitive with κελεύω [SMYTH:1992]. Present stem outside the indicative: aspect only, the action as ongoing [SMYTH:1859]. Active voice [MORPH].

2515.r: ἐκέλευσε “ordered”: the aorist [SMYTH:1923]. Active voice [MORPH]. Indicative of a statement or question [MORPH].

2516.r: The article makes Ὑρκανίοις a substantive [SMYTH:1153].

2517.r: λέγειν τοῖς Ὑρκανίοις “tell the Hyrcanians”: the indirect object [SMYTH:1469].

2521.r: ὡς ἂν ὁρῶσιν “according to the way in which they should see”: ἄν with the subjunctive in a relative clause of manner [SMYTH:2565]. Present stem outside the indicative: aspect only, the action as ongoing [SMYTH:1859]. Active voice [MORPH].

2522.n: TREE: αὐτούς is the object of ὁρῶσιν.
2522.r: ὁρῶσιν αὐτοὺς προσφερομένους “see the Hyrcanians behave”: the object of a verb of perception with a supplementary participle [CONV:R4]. Oblique αὐτός standing alone: the personal pronoun “him, her, it, them” [SMYTH:1212].

2523.r: ὁρῶσιν … προσφερομένους “see behave”: the supplementary participle with a verb of perception [CONV:R4]; προσφέρομαι “behave towards” [CONV:D3]. In indirect discourse the tense is that of the direct form [CONV:D7].

2527.r: οὕτω καὶ αὐτοί “so he and his army”: αὐτός emphatic, “they on their side” [SMYTH:1206].

2528.r: οὕτω … ποιήσουσιν “would govern their conduct”: the future, kept in indirect discourse [SMYTH:2579]. Active voice [MORPH]. Indicative of a statement or question [MORPH].

2532.r: ὁ μέν “the one”: the article as a pronoun [SMYTH:1106].

2534.r: μένει “remained”: the historical present [SMYTH:1883]. Active voice [MORPH]. Indicative of a statement or question [MORPH].

2535.r: Particular article: ἀγγέλων is a definite, identifiable referent [SMYTH:1119].

2536.r: ὁ μὲν … τῶν ἀγγέλων “one of the messengers”: the partitive genitive [SMYTH:1306].

2538.r: Article with the proper name Κύρῳ [SMYTH:1136].

2539.r: παρὰ τῷ Κύρῳ “with Cyrus”: παρά with the dative [PREP:παρά] [CONV:D1].

2541.r: ὁ δέ “the other”: the article as a pronoun [SMYTH:1106].

2543.r: προσελαύνει “rode away”: the historical present [SMYTH:1883]. Active voice [MORPH]. Indicative of a statement or question [MORPH].

2545.r: Article with the proper name Ὑρκανίους [SMYTH:1136].

2546.r: πρὸς τοὺς Ὑρκανίους “to the Hyrcanians”: πρός with the accusative of direction [PREP:πρός] [CONV:D1].

2549.r: ἐν ᾧ “while”: ἐν with the relative, “in the time in which” [PREP:ἐν] [COMM:en-holden-1887-books3-5:232].

2551.r: ἐσκόπει “was watching”: the imperfect [SMYTH:1889]. Active voice [MORPH]. Indicative of a statement or question [MORPH].

2552.r: Article with the proper name Ὑρκανίους [SMYTH:1136].

2553.r: ἐσκόπει τοὺς Ὑρκανίους ὅ τι ποιήσουσιν “watching to see what the Hyrcanians were going to do”: the anticipatory accusative, the subject of the question drawn into the main clause [SMYTH:2182] [COMM:en-holden-1887-books3-5:232].

2554.r: Article with the proper name Κῦρος [SMYTH:1136].

2556.r: ὅ τι ποιήσουσιν “what they would do”: the object [SMYTH:1553].

2557.r: Agrees with ὅ and takes its case function [MORPH].

2558.n: TREE: the question depends on ἐσκόπει.
2558.r: ὅ τι ποιήσουσιν “what they were going to do”: the future, kept in an indirect question [SMYTH:2677]. Active voice [MORPH]. Indicative of a statement or question [MORPH].

2560.r: ἐπέστησε “he halted”: the aorist [SMYTH:1923]. Active voice [MORPH]. Indicative of a statement or question [MORPH].

2561.r: Particular article: στράτευμα is a definite, identifiable referent [SMYTH:1119].

2562.r: ἐπέστησε τὸ στράτευμα “halted his army”: the object [SMYTH:1553].

2564.r: παρελαύνουσι “rode up”: the historical present [SMYTH:1883]. Active voice [MORPH]. Indicative of a statement or question [MORPH].

2567.r: πρὸς αὐτόν “to him”: πρός with the accusative of direction [PREP:πρός] [CONV:D1]. Oblique αὐτός standing alone: the personal pronoun “him, her, it, them” [SMYTH:1212].

2568.r: The article makes προεστηκότες a substantive [SMYTH:1153].

2569.r: Article with the proper name Μήδων [SMYTH:1136].

2570.r: οἱ τῶν Μήδων προεστηκότες “the officers of the Medes”: the genitive with a verb of ruling [SMYTH:1370].

2571.r: Subject of παρελαύνουσι [MORPH]. Perfect stem outside the indicative: a completed state [SMYTH:1859]. Active voice [MORPH]. Attributive or substantival participle [SMYTH:2049].

2573.r: Article with the proper name Τιγράνης [SMYTH:1136].

2576.r: ἐπερωτῶσι “asked”: the historical present [SMYTH:1883]. Active voice [MORPH]. Indicative of a statement or question [MORPH].

2578.r: τί δεῖ “what they should”: the present, kept in an indirect question [SMYTH:2677]. Active voice [MORPH]. Indicative of a statement or question [MORPH].

2579.r: δεῖ ποιεῖν “should do”: the infinitive as subject of δεῖ [SMYTH:1985]. Present stem outside the indicative: aspect only, the action as ongoing [SMYTH:1859]. Active voice [MORPH].

2581.r: ὁ δέ “and he”: the article as a pronoun [SMYTH:1106].

2583.r: λέγει “said”: the historical present [SMYTH:1883]. Active voice [MORPH]. Indicative of a statement or question [MORPH].

2584.r: λέγει αὐτοῖς “said to them”: the indirect object [SMYTH:1469]. Oblique αὐτός standing alone: the personal pronoun “him, her, it, them” [SMYTH:1212].

2587.r: ὅτι τοῦτʼ ἔστι “that this is”: the present, kept in indirect discourse [SMYTH:2579]. Active voice [MORPH]. Indicative of a statement or question [MORPH].

2588.n: TREE: τὸ πλησίον goes with τοῦτο, not with στράτευμα.
2588.r: τοῦτʼ … τὸ πλησίον “what you see there not far away”: the article makes the adverb a noun, going with τοῦτο as subject [SMYTH:1153] [COMM:en-bigg-1886-books4-5:122].

2590.n: TREE: Ὑρκανίων depends on στράτευμα, not on πλησίον as in the tree.
2590.r: Ὑρκανίων στράτευμα “the Hyrcanian army”: the possessive genitive [SMYTH:1297].

2591.r: Ὑρκανίων στράτευμα “is the Hyrcanian army”: the predicate nominative [SMYTH:909] [COMM:en-bigg-1886-books4-5:122].

2593.r: καὶ οἴχεται “and has gone”: οἴχομαι, present with perfect sense [SMYTH:1886]. οἴχομαι “be gone” is middle-only, a middle of motion [CONV:D3]. Indicative of a statement or question [MORPH].

2594.r: Particular article: ἕτερος is a definite, identifiable referent [SMYTH:1119].

2596.r: Particular article: ἀγγέλων is a definite, identifiable referent [SMYTH:1119].

2597.r: ὁ ἕτερος τῶν ἀγγέλων “one of their envoys”: the partitive genitive [SMYTH:1306].

2599.r: πρὸς αὐτούς “to them”: πρός with the accusative of direction [PREP:πρός] [CONV:D1]. Oblique αὐτός standing alone: the personal pronoun “him, her, it, them” [SMYTH:1212].

2601.r: The article makes ἡμετέρων a substantive [SMYTH:1153].

2602.r: τῶν ἡμετέρων τις “one of our men”: the partitive genitive [SMYTH:1306].

2605.r: Dative with σύν, “with”: accompaniment [PREP:σύν]; the tag gives the function of the phrase [CONV:D1]. Oblique αὐτός standing alone: the personal pronoun “him, her, it, them” [SMYTH:1212].

2607.r: ἐροῦντες “to tell”: the future participle of purpose [SMYTH:2065]. Future stem outside the indicative [SMYTH:1865]. Active voice [MORPH].

2611.r: εἰ φίλοι εἰσίν “if they are our friends”: the present indicative in a simple condition [SMYTH:2298]. Active voice [MORPH]. Indicative of a statement or question [MORPH].

2613.r: ἐροῦντες … ὑπαντιάζειν “to tell them to come to meet us”: λέγω “bid” with the infinitive [SMYTH:1997]. Present stem outside the indicative: aspect only, the action as ongoing [SMYTH:1859]. Active voice [MORPH].

2614.r: The article makes δεξιὰς a substantive [SMYTH:1153].

2615.r: τὰς δεξιὰς ἀνατείναντας “with their right hands upraised”: the object [SMYTH:1553] [COMM:en-holden-1887-books3-5:231].

2616.n: TREE: ἀνατείναντας depends on πάντας, not on ὑπαντιάζειν as in the tree.
2616.r: ἀνατείναντας πάντας “all, with hands upraised”: a circumstantial participle agreeing with πάντας [SMYTH:2060]. Aorist stem outside the indicative: aspect only, the action as a single whole [SMYTH:1859]. Active voice [MORPH].

2617.n: TREE: πάντας is the subject of ὑπαντιάζειν, not the object of ἀνατείναντας.
2617.r: ὑπαντιάζειν … πάντας “all to come to meet”: the subject of the infinitive [SMYTH:1972].

2623.r: ἢν μὲν οὖν οὕτω ποιῶσι “now if they do so”: ἐάν with the subjunctive [SMYTH:2323]. Present stem outside the indicative: aspect only, the action as ongoing [SMYTH:1859]. Active voice [MORPH].

2625.r: δεξιοῦσθέ τε αὐτούς “give them the right hand of fellowship”: the imperative [SMYTH:1835]; δεξιόομαι, middle-only [CONV:D3]. Present stem outside the indicative: aspect only, the action as ongoing [SMYTH:1859].

2627.r: δεξιοῦσθε … αὐτούς “greet them”: the object [SMYTH:1553]. Oblique αὐτός standing alone: the personal pronoun “him, her, it, them” [SMYTH:1212].

2629.r: καθʼ ὃν ἂν ᾖ ἕκαστος “each to the man opposite himself”: κατά with the accusative, “opposite” [PREP:κατά].

2631.r: ὃν ἂν ᾖ “opposite whom is”: ἄν with the subjunctive in a general relative clause [SMYTH:2567]. Present stem outside the indicative: aspect only, the action as ongoing [SMYTH:1859]. Active voice [MORPH].

2635.r: καὶ ἅμα θαρρύνετε “and at the same time bid them welcome”: the imperative [SMYTH:1835]. Present stem outside the indicative: aspect only, the action as ongoing [SMYTH:1859]. Active voice [MORPH].

2640.n: TREE: the lemma should be αἴρω.
2640.r: ἢν δὲ ὅπλα αἴρωνται “but if they raise a weapon”: ἐάν with the subjunctive [SMYTH:2323]; the indirect middle [SMYTH:1719]. Present stem outside the indicative: aspect only, the action as ongoing [SMYTH:1859].

2642.r: φεύγειν ἐπιχειρῶσι “attempt to run away”: the dynamic infinitive [SMYTH:1991]. Present stem outside the indicative: aspect only, the action as ongoing [SMYTH:1859]. Active voice [MORPH].

2643.r: ἢ … ἐπιχειρῶσι “or attempt”: ἐάν with the subjunctive [SMYTH:2323]. Present stem outside the indicative: aspect only, the action as ongoing [SMYTH:1859]. Active voice [MORPH].

2645.r: τούτων … μηδένα “not a single one of these”: the partitive genitive [SMYTH:1306].

2647.r: ἔφη “he said”: the imperfect of saying [CONV:R35]. Active voice [MORPH]. Indicative of a statement or question [MORPH].

2650.r: εὐθὺς δεῖ “we must lose no time”: the present [SMYTH:1875]. Active voice [MORPH]. Indicative of a statement or question [MORPH].

2651.r: τούτων … πρώτων “these first”: πρώτων agrees with τούτων [SMYTH:1020].

2652.r: δεῖ … πειρᾶσθαι “must try”: the infinitive as subject of δεῖ [SMYTH:1985]; πειράομαι “try” [CONV:D3]. Present stem outside the indicative: aspect only, the action as ongoing [SMYTH:1859].

2653.n: TREE: μηδένα is the object of λιπεῖν, not its subject.
2653.r: μηδένα λιπεῖν “to leave not a single one alive”: the object of λιπεῖν [SMYTH:1553].
